A lead agent can generate tasks rather than call a
The orchestrator decomposes a goal or dispatches a
Task plan, worker selection, delegation envelope,
Synthesized output accounts for generated task
Workers advertise capabilities and share a
Every dispatched task has a result or

Unsplittable, failed, or duplicate work is
1 submit(goal) → 2 decompose(goal) → 3 assign(subtask) → 4 return(result) → 5 synthesize(results) → 6 return(answer)

Variation: Planner-executor, manager-worker, sub-agent registry, and dynamic graph.
Negative control: A fixed sequence of sub-agents is W01 rather than dynamic W04.
